name: EaglePebble
desc: EaglePebble is a decentralized real estate development group that manages complex financial consolidations across multiple European markets. The company leverages Prophix to streamline reporting, improve data transparency, and support strategic decision-making for its investors.
whoText: EaglePebble is a decentralized real estate development group headquartered in Luxembourg. The company operates across three primary markets, including Belgium, France, and Luxembourg, managing complex financial consolidations for both statutory and IFRS reporting requirements.

data.label: BUSINESS CHALLENGES
data.heading: Navigating complex, decentralized consolidation
data.body:
Before Prophix, the group operated as a decentralized entity where financial data originated from disparate systems across Belgium, France, and Luxembourg. The consolidation process relied on receiving pre-consolidated contributions from subsidiaries, which lacked the necessary detail regarding local adjustments, intercompany eliminations, and specific financial movements. This fragmented approach forced the group consolidation manager to constantly revert to local teams for clarification, creating significant bottlenecks in the reporting workflow.

This status quo was unsustainable because it prevented the group from achieving a clear, granular view of its financial health, particularly regarding individual activity segments and clean funds. The lack of transparency hindered the ability to respond to investor inquiries and made it difficult to meet strict reporting deadlines. Without a unified system, the team struggled to maintain coherence across statutory local figures and IFRS requirements, necessitating a more robust and integrated solution.

data.label: WHY PROPHIX
data.heading: What made Prophix the right fit
data.body:
- Requirement for a unified system to integrate decentralized data from multiple international markets.
- Need for granular visibility into local adjustments, intercompany eliminations, and consolidation methods.
- Requirement for a user-friendly interface that supports complex reporting and strategic simulation capabilities.

data.label: KEY RESULTS
data.heading: Driving transparency and strategic agility
data.body:
The implementation of Prophix has transformed the group’s consolidation process into a transparent, efficient operation. By integrating France directly into the system, the team has moved away from relying on opaque, pre-consolidated contributions, allowing for a much deeper understanding of the financial data at both the local and group levels.

This enhanced visibility has significantly improved collaboration between the group consolidator and local country teams. The ability to utilize analytical dimensions and coherence controls has ensured that data is reliable and audit-ready, while the user-friendly interface allows for easier navigation and faster resolution of intercompany positions.

Most importantly, the group has achieved the ability to meet strict reporting deadlines for its investors. By moving from a manual, fragmented process to an automated system, the team now consistently respects its closing timelines while gaining the agility to simulate strategic scenarios, such as capital dilution, which were previously difficult to assess accurately.
